summary_1line: Markandeya recounts the origins of sacred fires and begins the tale leading to Kartikeya’s birth, including Indra rescuing Devasena from the Asura Kesin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra hurls his thunderbolt through the air, shattering the Asura Kesin’s flying mace while the terrified Devasena stands nearby.
Atharvan searches the vast ocean while gods gather anxiously as the lost cosmic fire is recovered from the waters.
At sunrise on the Udaya mountain, Indra witnesses red clouds, battling gods and Asuras, and Agni entering the blazing disc of the Sun.
